entities.name: MICO indication
entities.description: An information element that the UE may include to request the use of MICO (Mobile Initiated Connection Only) mode.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may include the MICO indication IE to request MICO mode.

entities.name: MICO mode
entities.description: Mobile Initiated Connection Only mode, a power saving mode where the UE only initiates connections.

relations.description: The UE may include the MICO indication IE to request MICO mode.
Inclusion of the MICO indication IE requests the use of MICO mode.
